name: Chunkies Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients_raw: WHEAT FLOUR, DARK CHOCOLATE CHIPS (SUGAR, COCOA POWDER, COCOA BUTTER, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER (SOY LECITHIN (E322)) & NATURAL FLAVOUR (VANILLA)), INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT (PALM & SESAME), SUGAR, SKIM MILK POWDER (FROM COW'S/BUFFALO'S MILK), MILK CHOCOLATE CHIPS (SUGAR, COCOA BUTTER, SKIM MILK POWDER (FROM COW'S/BUFFALO'S MILK), MILK FAT (FROM COW'S/BUFFALO'S MILK), COCOA POWDER, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER (SOY LECITHIN (E322)) & VANILLA (NATURAL FLAVOUR)), RAISING AGENTS (AMMONIUM BICARBONATE (E503(ii)), SODIUM ACID PYRO PHOSPHATE (E450(i)), BUTTER, BAKING POWDER (SODIUM BICARBONATE (E500(ii)), ACID CALCIUM PHOSPHATE (341(i))), CORN SYRUP, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, OATS POWDER, COCOA POWDER, SALT, EMULSIFIERS (MONO & DI GLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (PALM) (E471), SOY LECITHIN (E322)), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (CHOCOLATE, VANILLA).
